findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_service, check_service_area, get_contact_and_booking, get_reviews, get_faq · Private data: get_contact_and_booking · Public sink: get_contact_and_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_service, check_service_area, get_contact_and_booking, get_reviews, get_faq · Private data: get_contact_and_booking · Public sink: get_contact_and_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
